messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High error rate from serving pool `pool-usw2-gpu-1` (redwood-v1-xl). Symptoms: repeated container restarts, OOM on prefill for long-context prompts. Auto-throttle attempted and fallback not triggered.

maya: acknowledged. i'm oncall — gathering details. can someone grab the crash logs and nvml output?

raj: joining. grabbing `kubectl logs` and node dmesg now. suspect long prefill sequences hitting KV cache + large batch.

ellie: customer reports spike in 5xxs for a handful of tenants, seeing `ContainerRestartCount` alerts. forwarding relevant customer ids to cs.

sre-amber: quick note — saw `CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS` in one container prior to restart. nvml shows GPU mem pinned near 99%.

raj: paste of recent tail (cut):
```
[2026-03-15T02:11:23Z] serving-runtime: prefill received (tokens=9216)
[2026-03-15T02:11:24Z] runtime.cu: allocate(GB=10) -> success
[2026-03-15T02:11:24Z] runtime.cu: KV cache grow -> OOM
[2026-03-15T02:11:24Z] runtime: cuda: CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS
[2026-03-15T02:11:24Z] kernel: oom-killer: container 1234 invoked oom-killer
[2026-03-15T02:11:25Z] containerd: container exited (signal 9)
```

maya: thanks. mitigation plan proposal: (1) apply temporary env `MAX_PREFILL_TOKENS=4096` on `pool-usw2-gpu-1` (2) rollout fallback model variant `redwood-v1-xl-quant` or `redwood-v1-medium` for noisy tenants (3) cordon nodes showing repeated host-level OOMs, move pods to healthy nodes.

eng-runtime-lead: agree with plan. do (1) and (2) now. i'll also push a runtime patch to trim prefill if tokens>limit before allocating full KV.

raj: doing step 1: `kubectl set env ds/pool-usw2-gpu-1 MAX_PREFILL_TOKENS=4096 --namespace=serving`

ellie: started canary applying to 10% of pool — monitor 503/5xx rates.

customer-success-mike: quick customer update for affected tenant "BrightMaps": they reported timeouts ~02:12-02:20 UTC, their app saw degraded UX. i told them we're mitigating and will follow up with root cause.

maya: step 2 in progress: switching heavy-traffic tenant routes to `redwood-v1-medium` via routing policy. `curl` check shows healthy responses on medium variant.

sre-amber: observed immediate drop in GPU memory pressure on canary nodes after MAX_PREFILL_TOKENS applied. one node still showing flaps — isolating it.

raj: added node taint `prefill-problem=true:NoSchedule` to node `ip-10-2-9-17` to avoid rescheduling heavy pods. running `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets` on it.

ellie: rolling metrics: 5xx rate down from 6.2% -> 1.1% in 12 minutes for affected routes. latency improved for fallback traffic.

maya: marking incident as P1 -> P2 candidate if stable for 30m. still tracking node flap + crash sigs.

eng-runtime-lead: pushed a hotfix to runtime: prefill trimming logic (v1.2.3-hotfix). patch prevents KV growth until prefill trimmed; promotes earlier failure to controlled 429 rather than OOM. patch rolling out to pool.

raj: confirming hotfix logs show no subsequent CUDA illegal address traces on patched pods.

customer-success-mike: sent follow-up to BrightMaps: brief summary + ETA for postmortem. they asked for timeline on a permanent fix. i've let them know we'll have postmortem in 48h.

maya: preparing handoff to night oncall (ellie). key items for handoff:
- affected pool: `pool-usw2-gpu-1`
- mitigation applied: `MAX_PREFILL_TOKENS=4096`, route fallbacks to `redwood-v1-medium`, tainted node `ip-10-2-9-17`
- hotspot: one node had repeated host OOMs and was drained; needs hardware/infra check (possible flaky GPU driver)
- follow-ups: add regression test for long-prefill trimming, create alert for `prefill_token_count > 6000` per request, and run a small replay of top-100 long prompts in staging using quant/medium variants

ellie: ack handoff, i'll watch for reoccurrence overnight. leaving monitoring alerts at high sensitivity and will escalate if >0.5% 5xx persists for 10m.

sre-amber: note for postmortem: capture nvml logs and dmesg from `ip-10-2-9-17`, include `LD_PRELOAD` traces for third-party libs, and correlate with driver version `515.48`.

eng-runtime-lead: open action items:
- runtime: add prefill token cap config + automated trim (owner: raj)
- infra: investigate node GPU driver flakiness + possible kernel bug (owner: infra-lead)
- cs: customer communication + postmortem (owner: customer-success-mike)

maya: closing out immediate paging. thanks everyone. :thumbsup: will post final incident summary in ~24-48h once we have logs and root cause.

incident-bot: Incident update: status=mitigated, severity=high -> monitoring. assigned_to=maya, followup_group=eng-runtime, followup_ticket=INC-2026-4372

ellie: quick reminder — add a reproducible test to perf infra that runs a 9k-token prefill against quantized model to ensure graceful degradation.

raj: adding that to my queue now.

maya: handing off fully to ellie for overnight monitoring.

ellie: taking it. good work team. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
